# Rajan Sharma — Full-Stack Software Engineer (Extended Profile)

> Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Building production-grade web systems with Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

## About
- 16 production software systems engineered and deployed
- Core expertise: LMS platforms, POS systems, tourism portals, geospatial data pipelines
- Open to full-time engineering roles worldwide
- Based in Kathmandu, Nepal (UTC+5:45)

## Key Projects In-Depth

### Advanced LMS — Full-Stack Learning Management System
- Tech Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, Cloudinary
- Features: Comprehensive course management, secure JWT authentication, media storage via Cloudinary, and interactive student dashboards.
- Architecture: REST API backend coupled with a responsive Next.js frontend, utilizing Mongoose for schema validation.

### RestroOS — Restaurant Management System & POS
- Tech Stack: Next.js, Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL
- Features: Real-time order tracking, inventory management, billing, and reporting.
- Architecture: High-performance PostgreSQL database managed via Prisma ORM for type-safe data access.

### Nexzen Tour — Tourism & Geospatial Platform
- Tech Stack: Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, OpenStreetMap, Valhalla
- Features: Interactive maps, custom routing, and tour packages.
- Architecture: Integrated geospatial routing engine (Valhalla) with OSM data.

### OSM Nepal Pipeline — Geospatial Data Ingestion
- Tech Stack: Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Overpass API
- Features: Automated data ingestion for 77 districts in Nepal.
- Architecture: Scripted data pipelines querying Overpass API, transforming and storing geospatial data efficiently.

### Ambikeshori Travels — Production Travel Portal
- Tech Stack: Next.js, MongoDB
- Features: Booking engine, travel itineraries, and customer portal. Launched Feb 2026.

### BMW Tours and Travels — Tourism Portal
- Tech Stack: Next.js, MongoDB, cPanel
- Features: Tour showcases, inquiries, and admin management.

### LandBDevs — Engineering Consultancy Portal
- Tech Stack: Next.js, Express
- Features: Service listings, project portfolios, and contact workflows.

### AI Job Hunter — Automated Job Application Platform
- Tech Stack: Next.js, AI APIs
- Features: Resume parsing, cover letter generation, and job matching using AI.

### Japanese Learning Platform — JFT-Basic & JLPT N5
- Tech Stack: React, TypeScript
- Features: Flashcards, quizzes, and progress tracking for Japanese learners.

### NEA Level 5 Quiz App
- Tech Stack: React, Vite
- Features: High-performance quiz application with real-time scoring.

### Banau Clothing — E-Commerce
- Tech Stack: WordPress, WooCommerce
- Features: Online clothing store with payment gateway integration.

### Custom WordPress News Portal
- Tech Stack: WordPress, PHP
- Features: Dynamic news categorized layout with high traffic handling.

## Technical Stack Details
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, JWT, RBAC
- Databases: PostgreSQL (Prisma), MongoDB (Mongoose)
- Geospatial: OpenStreetMap, Overpass API, Valhalla Routing, OSRM
- Security: PBKDF2, HMAC, Rate Limiting, Helmet, CORS
- Cloud: Cloudinary, cPanel, Linux hosting
